title: Arbiter FSM Illegal State — Missing Default
description: The 2-bit arbiter FSM only handles states 0 and 1 in its case statement; if the state register reaches 2 or 3 via a scan-chain operation, the arbiter freezes without recovery.
bug_signature: UVM_FATAL: [FSM_LOCK] Arbiter state=2'h3 after scan; FSM frozen; no recovery path
expected_root_cause: The case statement for the 2-bit arbiter state machine handles only states 0 and 1; states 2 and 3 have no branch, causing synthesis to treat them as don't-cares which can result in the FSM locking up when those states are reached.
failure_log: UVM_FATAL: [FSM_LOCK] Arbiter state=2'h3 after scan; FSM frozen; no recovery path
success_log: Illegal state injection (state=2'h2): returns to 2'h0 next cycle. Arbiter resumes.
